title: BRP Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)

title: BRP Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)

The dressers do not comply with the performance requirements of the U.S. voluntary industry standard (ASTM 2057-19). Units: About 1,380.

summary: The children's robes fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 3,800.

summary: The hinge-closers can malfunction and not fully self-close gates when installed. This can lead to unintended access to pools and other areas, posing injury and drowning hazards to young children. Units: About 1,500.

title: Games Workshop Recalls Koyo Bounca The Squig Plush Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pom-poms can detach from the toy, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,600.

summary: The ATVs fail to comply with the requirements of the federal mandatory ATV safety standard. summary: The metal zipper slider, zipper 0-ring, d-ring, rivet and stud of the children's handbags contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 1,050.

title: Bebe au Lait Recalls Teethers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The string that connects the beads on the teethers can come untied, releasing the beads and posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 8,600 (In addition, about 10 units were sold in Canada).

summary: The resin and medium-density fiberboard ("MDF") menorahs can burn or catch fire when holding lit candles, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 7,900.

summary: The children's sleepwear sets fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 615 (In addition, 100 in Canada).

summary: The lithium-ion battery in the lawnmower can overheat, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 1,400.

title: Lovevery Recalls Drinking Cup With Handle in The Inspector Play Kits Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The handle can detach from the steel cup, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 169,000 (In addition, about 11,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Yamaha Recalls Golf Cars and Personal Transportation Vehicles Due to Risk of Injury or Death (Recall Alert)

summary: The steering shaft can separate from the joint and result in a loss of control, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 1,050.

title: Anecdote Candles Recalls Double-Wick Autumn Candles Due to Fire and Laceration Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Anthropologie
summary: The double wick candles can achieve higher than usual flames, causing the glass container to break apart, posing fire and laceration hazards. Units: About 19,380 (In addition, about 623 were sold in Canada).

title: Esme Recalls Children's Sleepwear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled children's sleepwear garments fail to meet the flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 3,600.

title: In-Things Recalls Scarves Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Saksoff5th.com
summary: The recalled scarves fail to meet flammability standards for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 200.

summary: The stroller's front wheels can break off while in use, causing the strollers to fall unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard to children in the stroller. Units: About 1,290.

title: Viking Range Recalls Freestanding Gas Ranges Due to Risk of Gas Leak and Fire Hazard
summary: The rigid gas tubing can separate at the joint to the bake, broil and griddle burners, posing a risk of a gas leak and fire hazard when these burners are in operation. Units: About 3,050.
